location.ref: Ghaṭ Rāmāyaṇ, the Rāmāyaṇa of the body

paraphrase: The true Rāmāyaṇa is within the body (ghaṭ): the soul must go up through the eye centre and the inner regions, hearing their sounds, to the true abode; Tulsī Sāhib says he told this in a former life as Tulsīdās, but the outer Rāmāyaṇa was taken instead.
speaker: Tulsī Sāhib
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Gist only; the claim about Tulsīdās is the text's own (recorded as its self-account).
